details:
Often, I enter a world where my friends are and most of the avatars I have shown on the screen disappear along with the players nametags and those become inaudible. This is often accompanied with one or two of my friend's avatars flickering in place, also inaudible with occasional bursts of garbled voice. Insofar as I can tell, I am still visible and audible to other players. 
The most or the player's avatars that I have blocked are visible and occasionally audible but I typically get sporatic bursts of garbled voice not unlike the sounds of distorted encrypted radio. The blocked avatars that were in the world when I joined are typically locked in place.
New players that join after I do don't usually present this glitch as far as I can tell but when I reset vrchat and return to that world, those same players will then have this glitch. Attempting to change worlds or rejoining the same world will typically result in VRChat softlocking, requiring me to end task and restart the app from Steam.
The app isn't locked completely as I can hit escape to see the menu, but I can't move my cursor down to the menu or move around in the world. Game audio such as world and menus sounds don't seem to be affected.
I have tested this on multiple machines with differing hardware, uninstalled and reinstalled VRC, deleted my cache, changed my settings, and tried different video driver packages. The glitch presents itself in VR and Desktop mode.
This seems to happened most often in world built in the Persona theme. Maybe it's a shader or some script, I do not know.
My current machine configuration is: R5 3600X, MSI B450m, 16GB DDR4 @ 3733, 1TB m.2 SSD, and an RX 580 with 8GB of video ram all running Windows 10. I use the Samsung Odyssey plus WMR headset.
Thank you in advance.
~Knob
title: Avatars flicker and most players are inaudible.
